objective: Measure full-answer accuracy on new representative NYC code research cases, with development and held-out sets separated. Target 200 cases after validating a 30-case pilot.
productionPolicy: No production changes during evaluation; do not change model settings. Local runner and temporary database only.
strictPass: Correct conclusion, applicability and supporting citations; no material false additions. Unnecessarily withheld answers are failures on answerable cases. Clarification is scored on a separate denominator.
sourcePolicy: Freeze answer keys and source excerpts before paid model execution. Verify against official enacted sources. An API verifier pass is not an independent grade.
holdoutPolicy: Keep held-out results uninspected during development changes. Any case used for tuning becomes regression-only. Preserve first-attempt failures.
statistics: Report question and conversation/family counts separately; correlated follow-ups are not independent samples. Include confidence intervals and do not claim product-wide 95 percent from a curated convenience sample.
repetitions: Repeat a preselected subset without changing prompts or facts and report disagreement.
deliverables: raw outputs, citations, model settings and costs
independent grading with unresolved ambiguities identified
failure analysis and next changes recommended
status: Completed bounded evaluation; report and costs reconciled. Production unchanged.95percent not established.

developmentContinuity.note: Related followups on development families; not70independent samples.

heldout.note: Mostly exact-source questions. Measures application and source completeness; limited evidence about freeform discovery.

gradingPolicy: Source-key review by the assistant, independent of the API verifier decision, but not blinded external professional adjudication. Report this limitation.
